title: Does the reader have to be a Dart isolate?
impact: Moonshot: rejected, and the vehicle question is now closed rather than open. Exps 265, 269, 270 and 275 each tried to collect claim 265.1's 6.3 us round trip by removing the worker, and each was rejected for a consequence of doing so — unbounded caller work, unbounded opaque SQLite work, foreign-writer staleness, zero incidence. None asked whether the worker has to be a Dart isolate: a POSIX thread keeps SQLite off the caller just as completely, and `Dart_PostCObject_DL` can deliver its completion. It is slower. A Dart isolate round trip costs 1.46 us; the same handoff to a native worker thread costs 4.28 us parked on a condvar and 3.18 us with the worker spinning on the queue and burning a core, so the primitive cannot be blamed. A native post issued from the calling thread, where nothing has to be woken, costs 0.67 us — the whole 2-3 us gap is the cross-thread wake, which the VM's same-group message path does in both directions for less. End to end a one-row `selectBytes` through the native thread is +17.3%, a 1,000-row one +1.1%, and 5,000 rows inside the noise floor: never faster at any size. Two findings outlive the rejection. A point read's entire transport is 3.22 us, about half of the 6.3 us hop, so the other half is resqlite's own per-request work on the two sides of the messages and that is where the remaining headroom lives. And the VM charges for a payload's backing rather than its size: 256 KB as a view over malloc'd memory sends in 9.01 us, the identical 256 KB as a heap `Uint8List` in 43.06 us — 4.8x, the number behind exp 174's view-send and a standing constraint on any path that would assemble bytes on the Dart heap first. Zero-copy external-typed-data handoff is the one lane where native dispatch leads (5.63 vs 9.01 us), but realizing it means handing `json_buf` over and forfeiting the reuse exp 174 found decisive, for 1.4% of a 1,000-row read. Runtime reverted; prototype at `archive/exp-279`; the isolate-only lanes are retained as `benchmark/experiments/isolate_transport_price.dart`.
